how: `x` takes its default 2147483647, the largest `i32`, and the literal 1 takes the type `i32` of the other operand (spec 3.4), so `core.add` of two `i32` gives 2^31, which an `i32` cannot hold, and `core.add` has no `err`: the fault `LC8008` at the node `y` (spec 8.2, A.1; cli.md 6.6). No loop is around it; no output (spec 8.2), no resource. The simulated clock stays at 0 ms: nothing waits before the fault, and only what waits takes simulated time (spec 8, discrete-event clock).
